requirement.description: The Flask hook implementation doesn't properly detect and hook Flask applications created in test modules. The test cases are failing because Flask app instances aren't being correctly identified and instrumented when they're created dynamically in test contexts.
requirement.contract: The hook_flask function must properly detect Flask app instances regardless of how they are created (direct instantiation, module-level assignments, or dynamic creation in test functions) and correctly hook all view functions and error handlers associated with those apps.

requirement.description: The generic hook mechanism needs improved detection of Flask apps when they are created in test modules. The current implementation has complex logic that may not correctly identify Flask apps when they are created dynamically during test execution.
requirement.contract: The hook_generic function must reliably detect Flask app instances passed as initiators and properly hook all view functions and error handlers from those apps, even when they are created in test contexts rather than imported modules.
